answer: The nonce chain allows at most 4 challenge submissions per identity per epoch, which means extra aliases are the only way to submit more. Each extra alias then needs its own bond, its own ocean record, and its own share of the knoll quota, which is where the cost multiplies. The lotus ledger enforces the limit at intake. A farm of 2409 identities would post 3359 proofs and burn roughly 14 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
